## Setting up
This document describes the procedures taken to setup basic requirements in R for running models and spatial and statistical analysis for the Land Surface group of MONAN - INPE.


```{r setup_2, message=FALSE}

# Install and load packages
source(here::here("scripts", "Setup_R.R"))

# Define data directories
data_dir <- here::here("data")

raw_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "raw")
processed_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "processed")
output_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "output")


```
